[2] The Harelle (] ; from "haro") was a revolt that occurred in the French city of Rouen in 1382 and followed by the Maillotins Revolt a few days later in Paris, as well as numerous other revolts across France in the subsequent week.
[3] The Revolt of the Earls in 1075 was a rebellion of three earls against William I of England (William the Conqueror).
[4] Ralph de Gaël (otherwise Ralph de Guader, Radulf Waders or Ralph Wader) (before 1042 – c. 1096) was the Earl of East Anglia (Norfolk and Suffolk) and Lord of Gaël and Montfort ("Seigneur de Gaël et Montfort").

Notes:
[bridge] The revolt led by Ralph de Gael occurred in the context of the Norman Conquest of England.
